summary: Cadet Orbit is an open-source 2D educational quiz game designed to make astronomy and science more accessible to students, especially in public schools. Players follow an aspiring astronaut through missions inspired by past NASA space missions, solving challenges at space stations and answering science questions at interactive terminals. By combining gameplay, problem-solving, and educational content, the project turns learning into an engaging experience and helps address the limited access to astronomy education. Our goal is to spark curiosity, strengthen scientific knowledge, and inspire young people to pursue their dreams in science and space exploration.
details:
Cadet Orbit is an open-source 2D educational quiz game designed to make astronomy and space science more accessible to young students, especially those in public schools.

Players take the role of an aspiring astronaut and progress through missions inspired by real NASA space missions. During each mission, they face challenges in space-station environments, solve problems, and answer science questions through interactive terminals.

The game combines exploration, problem-solving, and educational quizzes to transform scientific learning into an engaging experience. Its main goal is to encourage curiosity, expand scientific knowledge, and inspire young people to explore careers in science and space exploration.

The project was developed using AntiGravity, Phaser, TypeScript, and Claude Code.
